title: Tanreqing injection demonstrates anti-dengue activity through the regulation of the NF-kappaB-ICAM-1/VCAM-1 axis.
authors: Yang, Jiabin; Chen, Xi; He, Xuemei; Fang, Xiaochuan; Liu, Shanhong; Zou, Lifang; Cao, Huihui; Liu, Junshan; Zuo, Jianping; Yu, Linzhong; Lu, Zibin
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药注射液抗登革病毒作用机制，涉及NF-kappaB通路和分子对接，但核心是病毒-宿主免疫调节，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Tanreqing injection (TRQ) has been employed in clinical practice as a treatment for dengue fever (DF). Nevertheless, the precise pharmacological mechanism underlying its efficacy remains elusive. METHOD: Network pharmacology, molecular docking, transcriptome sequencing, and experimental evaluation were employed to analyze and study the inhibitory potential of TRQ against dengue virus (DENV). RESULT: We found that TRQ inhibited the replication of DENV in human umbilical vein endothelial cells, Huh-7 cells, and Hep3B cells. In addition, TRQ prolonged the survival duration of AG129 mice infected with DF, decreased the viral load in serum and organs, and alleviated organ damage. Subsequently, ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry analysis of TRQ was performed to identify 314 targets associated with 36 active compounds present in TRQ. Integration of multiple databases yielded 47 DF-related genes. Then, 15 hub targets of TRQ in DF were determined by calculating the network topology parameters (Degree). Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analyses revealed that these pathways were primarily enriched in the processes of cytokine activation and leukocyte cross-endothelial migration, with significant enrichment of cell adhesion molecules. Molecular docking revealed favorable binding affinity between TRQ's key active compounds and the predicted hub targets. Transcriptome sequencing results showed TRQ's ability to restore the expression of vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1) post-DENV infection. Finally, TRQ was found to modulate the immune status by regulating the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB)- intercellular cell adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1)/VCAM-1 axis, as well as reduce immune cell alterations, inflammatory factor secretion, vascular permeability, and bleeding tendencies induced by DENV infection. CONCLUSION: Our research suggests that TRQ exerts therapeutic effects on DF by regulating the NF-kappaB-ICAM-1/VCAM-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：痰热清注射液（TRQ）已在临床上用于治疗登革热（DF）。然而，其疗效背后的确切药理机制仍不清楚。方法：采用网络药理学、分子对接、转录组测序和实验评估来分析和研究TRQ对登革病毒（DENV）的抑制潜力。结果：我们发现TRQ在人脐静脉内皮细胞、Huh-7细胞和Hep3B细胞中抑制了DENV的复制。此外，TRQ延长了感染DF的AG129小鼠的生存时间，降低了血清和器官中的病毒载量，并减轻了器官损伤。随后，对TRQ进行了超高效液相色谱-串联质谱分析，以鉴定TRQ中36种活性化合物相关的314个靶点。整合多个数据库得到47个DF相关基因。然后，通过计算网络拓扑参数（Degree）确定了TRQ在DF中的15个核心靶点。基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书分析显示，这些通路主要富集在细胞因子激活和白细胞跨内皮迁移过程中，并显著富集了细胞粘附分子。分子对接显示TRQ的关键活性化合物与预测的核心靶点之间具有良好的结合亲和力。转录组测序结果显示，TRQ能够恢复DENV感染后血管细胞粘附分子-1（VCAM-1）的表达。最后，发现TRQ通过调节核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）-细胞间粘附分子-1（ICAM-1）/VCAM-1轴来调节免疫状态，并减少DENV感染诱导的免疫细胞改变、炎症因子分泌、血管通透性和出血倾向。结论：我们的研究表明，TRQ通过调节NF-kappaB-ICAM-1/VCAM-1轴对DF发挥治疗作用。
